requirements.text: Enhance the library experience for both students and staff.
Automate fine calculations.
Create an efficient system for tracking overdue items.
Provide robust tools to manage inventory and generate reports on usage.
Integrate with the university's existing student record system.
Handle student data responsibly, complying with GDPR requirements.
Allow students to search the library catalogue for real-time availability of books and materials.
Enable online borrowing, returning, and renewing of items.
Provide a user-friendly room booking system optimized for mobile use.
Give students visibility into their current loans, due dates, and outstanding fines.
Send automated reminders for due dates three days and one day before the due date.
Block new loans or bookings for students with overdue fines above a certain threshold.
Set the blocking threshold for new loans or bookings at around £10 to £15 in overdue fines.
Provide reports on loan volumes to track borrowing trends.
Provide reports on the most frequently borrowed items.
Provide reports on room utilization, including usage frequency and peak times.
Provide insights into revenue from overdue fines.
Provide reports on student account activity, including overdue items and renewals.
Provide demographic insights on borrowing patterns.
Develop the system within a limited budget, prioritizing features strategically.
Ensure smooth integration with the existing university student record system.
Comply with data handling regulations beyond GDPR, including data retention and deletion policies.
Ensure compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
Assess current university infrastructure capabilities for supporting new functionalities.
Provide training and support for staff and students during the transition to the new system.
